imei.title: Scan IMEI
imei.hint: Point the camera at the IMEI barcode on the box or under Settings → About.
imei.ignored: This barcode isn't a valid IMEI. Try the code labelled "IMEI".

serial.title: Scan serial number
serial.hint: Point the camera at the barcode labelled "S/N" or "Serial No." on the device or box.
serial.ignored: That's a product code (EAN) or an IMEI. Try the code labelled "S/N".

reference.title: Scan reference number
reference.hint: Point the camera at the barcode or QR code on the certificate, warranty card or tag.
reference.ignored: That's a product code (EAN). Try the code labelled "Ref.".

codeScanner.permission: Allow camera access to scan barcodes.

deviceCodes.imeiInvalid: Invalid IMEI (15 digits, check digit doesn't match).
